visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black sports bra and navy blue sweatpants, begins a stretching routine on a light-colored yoga mat. The sun-drenched room features a glass ceiling and large windows. She starts on all fours, extending one leg out to the side while reaching her opposite arm towards the ceiling, showing a focused facial expression. (2) She transitions into a deeper floor stretch, threading her arm beneath her torso to rest her shoulder and head on the mat. The background reveals a clean domestic environment with a cat tree and a laundry machine visible through a glass door. Her movements are fluid and deliberate as she holds the twisting pose. (3) The scene cuts to her standing on the mat. She performs a quad stretch by pulling her right foot toward her glutes. She then transitions into a challenging one-legged squat, bringing her hands together in a prayer position at her chest, maintaining balance with a calm, concentrated look. (4) She sits cross-legged in a meditative pose. A fluffy grey cat enters from the right and wanders around her. She breaks her meditation briefly to pet and acknowledge the cat with a gentle smile. She then returns to a prayer pose with her eyes closed, as the cat lingers nearby in the bright living space.
